subject: Vendor onboarding: Lumenix legal entity + PO routing confirmation
body:
From: Asha Rao <asha@lumenix.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: payables@lumenix.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lumenix - vendor setup info and requested docs

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for taking onboarding for Lumenix. Per our conversation with your procurement team earlier today, attaching the following:
- Lumenix_W9_2026.pdf (signed)
- Lumenix_Banking_Instructions.xlsx (ACH details, bank contact)

Quick summary of our legal/payables details:
Legal name: Lumenix Inc.
Entity type: C-Corp (Delaware)
Tax ID / EIN: 12-3456789
Registered address: 4100 Harbor Way, Suite 200, San Diego, CA 92101
Remit address (if different): PO Box 5203, San Diego, CA 92105
Primary AP contact: Asha Rao, Head of Finance (asha@lumenix.com, +1 619-555-0142)
Preferred invoicing: e-invoice to payables@lumenix.com; ACH preferred.
PO terms: Net 45 per stated SOW; please confirm if Redwood needs full invoice-to-PO matching.

If you need anything else (beneficial ownership, additional attestations, or entity formation docs), happy to provide.

Regards,
Asha Rao
Head of Finance | Lumenix Inc.

---

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@lumenix.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumenix - vendor setup info and requested docs

Hi Asha — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of clarifying items from procurement before we kick off the vendor master creation in our ERP: 

1) Legal entity verification: can you confirm the Delaware filing # (state registration number) and attach the certified formation documents? We need on-file proof of incorporation.
2) PO matching requirements: Redwood currently enforces 2-way PO-invoice match by default; for services with SOWs we can enable 3-way matching. Is your invoicing team expecting invoice line-level matching to the SOW?
3) ACH remit: we require a bank letter or voided check in addition to the spreadsheet for ACH setup. Could your bank provide a bank letter on letterhead or your AP team send a scanned voided check?
4) Remit contact & escalation: please provide the name and phone number of someone who can approve payment issues (not just the submitter).

Once we have the formation doc and either the bank letter or voided check, I will create the vendor record and route it for AP verification. Estimated turnaround ~3 business days after receipt.

CCing Kimberly (AP) and Marissa (Vendor Operations) to align on PO channel and contract-to-pay flow.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Vendor Onboarding Specialist | Redwood Inference

---

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Lumenix missing docs

Nikhil — quick note: for ACH we need either bank letter OR a bank-validated ACH enrollment form plus a voided check. If they only have the spreadsheet we can’t proceed. Also confirm whether the W9 is EFT-signature acceptable (looks signed by CFO) — if not, we'll request original.

Marissa — FYI I’ll handle the bank validation and add a hold on payments until AP completes KYC.

K

---

From: Asha Rao <asha@lumenix.com>

Cc: payables@lumenix.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumenix - vendor setup info and requested docs

Hi Nikhil — thanks, attaching the state filing and bank letter you requested.

Attachments included:
- Lumenix_Cert_of_Incorporation_CA.pdf (state filing copy)
- Lumenix_Bank_Letter_2026.pdf (bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account/name/ACH routing)

The AP escalation is: Priya Suresh, AP Manager (priya.suresh@lumenix.com, +1 619-555-0199).

We are good with Redwood’s default invoice-to-PO matching. We invoice at the SOW level and include PO numbers; no line-level reconciliation required.

Let us know once vendor record is created and if you need the signed contract redline.

Thanks,
Asha

---

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@lumenix.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lumenix - vendor setup info and requested docs

Asha — perfect, thank you. I have everything needed. I’ll create the vendor master and submit to AP for verification and ACH validation. 

Next steps (internal):
- Create vendor record in NetLedger: legal name = Lumenix Inc.; tax id = 12-3456789; remit = PO Box 5203, San Diego CA 92105.
- Attach W9 and Certificate of Incorporation to record.
- AP to run bank letter validation and set up ACH.
- Add Priya Suresh as escalation contact and payables@lumenix.com as invoice receiver.

Asha — expected confirmation back to you by Mon, 02 Nov 2026 with vendor ID and test ACH confirmation. If AP needs anything else I’ll loop you in.

Thanks again,
Nikhil
Vendor Onboarding Specialist | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0182
